# Fixture sources

- `cherry-upstream.ctd` is the seven-node XML sample from marph91/jimmy-test-data, `test_data/cherrytree/test_1_frontmatter/cherry.ctb.ctd`. It has one PNG, two LaTeX sources, and one text attachment. Source: https://github.com/marph91/jimmy-test-data
- `cherry-fixture.ctd` is the ten-node XML sample from giuspen/cherrytree, `tests/data_данные/test_документ.ctd`. It has one shared node. Source: https://github.com/giuspen/cherrytree
- `cherry-small-fixture.ctd` is a local seven-node test document. It has four copies of the PNG from the upstream sample.

These files are test data. They are not part of the runtime bundle.
